name: registry path: renaming the anchor while flipping is refused
description: The registry fixture holds a run bound to plan-a-step-1, imported from a session whose key is gone, so it is not eligible to hand off (the empty Galaxy fixture can't re-verify it). Deny mode. In one edit the model flips the checkbox and renames the anchor. The legacy path sees no completion (gate-scripted-legacy-anchor-rename); the registry path finds the held step gone and refuses it.
